name: Test wound-induced hair neogenesis in adult human skin xenografts after large excision

design.model: adult human skin xenografts with large full-thickness excisional wounds
design.intervention: wound size series with and without Wnt agonism
design.readout: de novo follicles distinguished from surviving follicles by lineage and position

discriminates: Neogenesis in human skin with Wnt support shows competence is retained; none under any condition supports postnatal loss.
